thag2.2:1.1: Na idaṃ anayena jīvitaṃ, nāhāro hadayassa santiko, āhāraṭṭhitiko samussayo, iti disvāna carāmi esanaṃ. || ||
thag2.2:2.1: paṅko 'ti hi naṃ avedayuṃ yāyaṃ vandanapūjanā kulesu, sukhumaṃ sallaṃ durubbahaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisena dujjaho 'ti. || || itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Piṇḍolabhāradvājo thero gāthāyo abhāsitthā 'ti.
